question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"quite."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Quite"** means to a certain extent or degree. (अधिक नहीं; किसी हदतक; अपेक्षाकृत)
 
• It is an adverb that can modify adjectives, verbs, or other adverbs.
 
 
• **Example**: *The movie was **quite**__ entertaining*.
 
 
 
• The adverb **"quite"** is modifying the adjective **"natural."**
